rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths stood for God through God; one who stands by God turns from everything else, and one who stands for God continues until reaching Him.
rows.anchor: قاموا لله بالله ، ومن قام بالله فقد عما سوى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Attributing events to created contingencies as independent causes is shirk; claiming events come from other than God makes that other thing a deity.
rows.anchor: من أحال الشيء على الحوادث فقد أشرك بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A religious claim without rational or transmitted proof is fabrication; a spiritual state must be earned through sincere striving, and the truthful hear inwardly from the Real before speaking.
rows.anchor: فمن اكتفى بنفي القالة دون ما يشهد لقوله من أدلته فهو معلول في نحلته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Detachment from everything besides God brings union with God; those who left idolatry were sheltered by divine care.
rows.anchor: العزلة عن غير الله توجب الوصلة بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who relinquishes self-directed plans, returns sincerely to God, and relies on no peer is sheltered, relieved of burdens, and given a place in divine favor.
rows.anchor: ويقال من تبرأ من اختياره في احتياله ، وصدق رجوعه إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outwardly, sunlight did not spread over the youths in their part of the cave, even as winds blew over them.
rows.anchor: كانوا في تسع من الكهف ، ولكن كان شعاع الشمس لا ينبسط عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths' lights of gnosis surpass sunlight: the sun illuminates creatures outwardly, while their knowledge illuminates the Real inwardly.
rows.anchor: إن نور الشمس ضياء يستضيء به الخلق ، ونور معارفهم أنوار يعرف بها الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun's rays turning away indicates an event contrary to ordinary nature and may be counted among the saints' marvels.
rows.anchor: فيه دلالة على أن في الأمر شيئا بخلاف العادة ، فيكون من جملة كرامات الأولياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God guides some through proofs and others through unveiled certainty: the first know by inference, while the latter experience communion as if by direct sight.
rows.anchor: فالله يهدي قوما بالأدلة والبراهين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those branded with deprivation have no gnosis, knowledge, or faith.
rows.anchor: من وسمه بسمة الحرمان فلا عرفان ولا علم ولا إيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths were outwardly present to observers but inwardly absorbed and effaced in what was unveiled to them of the Real; in reality another acted through them.
rows.anchor: هم مسلوبون عنهم ، مختطفون منهم ، مستهلكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning them from side to side describes God's sheltering care, more complete than a mother's tenderness and more precious than a father's mercy.
rows.anchor: وهذا إخبار عن حسن إيوائه لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The knowers of unity appear outwardly differentiated but inwardly witness unity, and their actions unfold without affectation.
rows.anchor: فهم بشواهد الفرق في ظاهرهم ، لكنهم بعين الجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A lover loves those associated with the beloved; the dog is remembered alongside the youths through the Resurrection.
rows.anchor: ومن صدق في محبة أحد أحب من انتسب إليه

rows.speaker: التفاسير
rows.claim: A reported version says the shepherd would not send away the dog because he had raised it; another says God made the dog speak and refuse to leave its caretaker.
rows.anchor: ويقال في التفاسير إنهم قالوا للراعي الذي تبعهم والكلب معه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dog's lowly value and impure qualities did not harm it because it kept company with the youths.
rows.anchor: لما صحبهم الكلب لم تضره نجاسة صفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God conceals His saints from outsiders through protective jealousy; only intimates sharing their state recognize them.
rows.anchor: فهم في كتم الغيرة وإيواء الستر

rows.speaker: شيوخ هذه الطائفة
rows.claim: Sufi masters describe the Sufis as one household into which outsiders do not enter.
rows.anchor: كذلك قال شيوخ هذه الطائفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who do not know the saints' condition cannot be consulted about it; a heart without love for the beloveds cannot remember them truly.
rows.anchor: فلا يصح استفتاء من غاب علمهم عنه في حالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since events issue from God's will, one who knows God cannot promise future action as if it were completed by oneself.
rows.anchor: إذا كانت الحوادث صادرة عن مشيئة الله فمن عرف الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A believer resolves to obey while inwardly disclaiming personal power and witnessing what unfolds through divine decree.
rows.anchor: ويقال المؤمن يعزم على اعتناق الطاعة في مستقبله بقلبه ،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When forgetfulness comes, remembrance should strip one's purpose from the homeland of heedlessness; noticing one's own remembrance is itself a flaw.
rows.anchor: فجرد بذكرك قصدك عن أوطان غفلتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remember God after forgetting one's share in Him or forgetting everything besides Him.
rows.anchor: ويقال واذكر ربك إذا نسيت حظك منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths were so absorbed they did not notice time passing; God nevertheless counted their breaths.
rows.anchor: لم يقفوا على تطاول مدتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Recitation of revelation consoles the Prophet through changing circumstances, like a beloved's letter that heals its recipient.
rows.anchor: بما نطلعك عليه من الأخبار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one can alter God's words or decree; the rejected cannot be accepted, while those brought near cannot be barred from reaching Him.
rows.anchor: فمن أقصاه فلا قبول له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command says to restrain the Prophet's self rather than his heart because his heart was already with God; outward conduct is directed publicly while the heart is reserved inwardly.
rows.anchor: لأن قلبه كان مع الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about seeking God's face functions as a circumstantial expression and signals that their morning and evening invocation and intention continue without interruption.
rows.anchor: معناها مريدين وجهه أي في معنى الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sheltered these seekers in worldly life through His great gifts and in the afterlife through His generous gifts; He also disclosed their hidden qualities.
rows.anchor: فآويناهم في دنياهم بعظائمنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once freed from suspicion, they became free of desire for and love of every created being.
rows.anchor: لما زالت التهم سلمت لهم هذه الإرادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Out of reverence for the Prophet and the divine threshold, the poor did not press their request; he was told not to avert his gaze from them for worldly adornment.
rows.anchor: لما تقاصر لسانهم عن السؤال هذه الجملة مراعاة منهم لهيبة الرسول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's gaze upon the poor companions serves as their means toward God and compensates them for not seeing Him until the afterlife.
rows.anchor: جعلنا نظرك اليوم إليهم ذريعة لهم إلينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heedless include people who asked the Prophet to clear his gathering of the poor; heedlessness also means being occupied with blessings instead of their Giver.
rows.anchor: أي شغلناهم بما لا يعنيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Negligence is spending time on something other than fulfilling an obligation or performing a voluntary act.
rows.anchor: الغفلة تزجية الوقت في غير قضاء فرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The permission to believe or disbelieve is the utmost threat: faith benefits believers themselves, while punishment falls on deniers.
rows.anchor: أي إن آمنتم ففوائد إيمانكم عليه مقصورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gains no benefit from universal faith and suffers no loss from universal disbelief.
rows.anchor: عزيز لا يعود إليه بإيمان الكافة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The great punishment occupies the damned with pain so they cannot attend to regret for having missed the truth.
rows.anchor: العقوبة الكبرى لهم أن يشغلهم بالألم حتى لا يتفرغوا عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Real is too generous to punish someone who is accused or blamed on His account.
rows.anchor: أكرم من أن يعذب أحدا يتهم لأجله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Recognizing who calls their resting place evil might console the damned, but they fail to recognize the speaker.
rows.anchor: لعله كان لهم تسل ساعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise's gardens are good for its inhabitants, while the Fire's enclosure surrounds its inhabitants; God gains nothing from either punishment or reward.
rows.anchor: أهل الجنة طابت لهم حدائقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The best action is governed by sincerity and includes no self-congratulation or claim to a share.
rows.anchor: العمل أحسنه ما كان مضبوطا بشرائط الإخلاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Excellence includes seeing one's needs met only through God's grace and disclaiming one's own power.
rows.anchor: الإحسان في العمل ألا ترى قضاء حاجتك إلا في فضله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The garden's delights signify intimacy, nearness, union, and love, and its pure drink purifies hearts from love of created beings.
rows.anchor: ويأخذون بيد الزلفة ما يتحفهم الحق به من غير واسطة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's statement that He could hasten punishment, followed by His not doing so, demonstrates power to act otherwise than what was known to occur.
rows.anchor: تدل على صحة قدرته على خلاف ما علم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the hamza in “better” is not intensive, the verse means repel evil with good; if intensive, retaliation is allowed but forgiveness is more excellent.
rows.anchor: يجوز ألا تكون للمبالغة ؛ ويكون المعنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command is glossed as repaying harshness with fidelity and sin with kindness, choosing generosity over retaliation.
rows.anchor: ويقال ادفع الجفاء بالوفاء ، وجرم أهل العصيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inwardly, good follows the heart or spiritual reality, while evil is prompted by the lower self or Satan; good is also the light of spiritual realities.
rows.anchor: ويقال الأحسن ما أشار إليه القلب ، والسيئة ما تدعو إليه النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss contrasts the light of spiritual realities with the darkness of created things.
rows.anchor: ويقال الأحسن نور الحقائق ، والسيئة ظلمة الخلائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ultimately refuge is sought in God from God, but people are commanded to seek His refuge from Satan and whatever harms through ordinary causes.
rows.anchor: الاستعاذة - على الحقيقة - تكون بالله من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If Satan could mislead others, he would first keep himself from guidance; one unable to preserve himself is still less able to mislead others.
rows.anchor: فلو كان بالشيطان من إغواء الخلق شيء لكان يمسك على الهداية نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At death, when distress has seized them and escape is impossible, people plead and submit; they are told they should have done so earlier.
rows.anchor: إذ أخذ البلاء بخناقهم ، واستمكن الضر من أحوالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poem urges the soul to return before the road is blocked.
rows.anchor: قلت للنفس : إن أردت رجوعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that Day, kinship and regret do not help; each person meets the result of what they earned, and acknowledgment and excuses come too late.
rows.anchor: يومئذ لا تنفع الأنساب وتنقطع الأسباب ، ولا ينفع الندم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The damned acknowledge truth only on a day when admission and excuses do not benefit them.
rows.anchor: ولكن في يوم لا ينفع فيه الإقرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The damned ask to leave Hell and act righteously, but are answered that they had a life long enough for reflection and a warner.
rows.anchor: أما جاءكم النذير قبل أن تبلغوا زمان المشيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss asks whether they had completed the respite in which they could consider evidence.
rows.anchor: ألم تستوفوا مدة الإمهال في النظر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows the sincerity of the sincere, truth of the truthful, hypocrisy of hypocrites, and denial of disbelievers.
rows.anchor: عالم بإخلاص المخلصين ، وصدق الصادقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each generation succeeds the one before: some are worthy bearers while others are base; the virtuous and base each test their age.
rows.anchor: أهل كل عصر خليف عمن تقدمهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes idolaters see their idols' helplessness to expose poor judgment, low aims, and lack of reason.
rows.anchor: كرر إشهادهم عجز أصنامهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God holds the heavens and earth by His power, perfects them by wisdom, orders them by will, and has no partner in sustaining or dissolving them.
rows.anchor: أمسكها بقدرته ، وأتقنهما بحكمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers' pledge to follow a warner was false; similarly, an aspirant may promise God in zeal but be overcome by appetite and Satan, lose standing, and have his plot rebound.
rows.anchor: ليس لقولهم تحقيق ، ولا لعهدهم وضمانهم توثيق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God delays full reward and punishment because short human lives cannot contain them, postponing their completion to the long Day of Resurrection.
rows.anchor: لو عجل لهم ما يستوجبونه من الثواب والعقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The punishment for claiming a divine child is deprivation of the thing claimed before one can verify or experience it.
rows.anchor: وعقوبته أن يحرمه ذلك الشيء الذي تصدى له بدعواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Addressing those who called Christ or Ezra God's son, the argument says that if God wanted offspring for adoption or honor, He would choose angels free of human traits.
rows.anchor: خاطبهم على قدر عقولهم وعقائدهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is exalted above having children literally or by adoption; the hypothetical shows the claim's absurdity, like the argument that multiple gods would cause disorder.
rows.anchor: لا في الحقيقة لاستحالة معناه في نعته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created the heavens and earth rightly, and night and day enter into one another as they lengthen and shorten.
rows.anchor: أي خلقهما وهو محق في خلقهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The alternation of day and night also signifies the servant's changing states: contraction and expansion, union and separation, sobriety and ecstasy, doubt and connection.
rows.anchor: اختلاف أحوال العبد في القبض والبسط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates people through stages in three darknesses: abdomen, womb, and placenta; recalling this origin should prevent self-admiration.
rows.anchor: فى ظلمات ثلاث } : ظلمة البطن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some organs house qualities such as knowledge, power, and life, while others serve the senses.
rows.anchor: سخر بعضها محال للصفات الحميدة كالعلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These gifts remind people of God, since souls and hearts naturally love their benefactor, drawing them to love Him.
rows.anchor: ويقال هذه كلها نعم أنعم الله بها علينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God identifies Himself as Creator, Provider, shaper, benefactor, and guide who teaches people His unity and requires them to keep His limits.
rows.anchor: أنا خلقتكم وأنا رزقتكم وأنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet fears the kinds of punishment that will occur on the Great Day.
rows.anchor: أخاف أصناف العذاب التي تحصل في ذلك اليوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning to worship as one chooses is the utmost threat; the true loser sacrifices worldly life to desire, the afterlife by disobedience, and his relationship with his Master through shamelessness.
rows.anchor: هذا غاية الزجر والتهديد ، ثم بين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hell's enclosure keeps its inhabitants from escape or respite; people already dwell in the Hell of their beliefs behind an enduring veil.
rows.anchor: فهم لا يخرجون منها ، ولا يفترون عنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fearing God now protects one from the fear of that Day; otherwise a difficult ascent lies ahead.
rows.anchor: إن خفت اليوم كفيت خوف ذلك اليوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each person's idol is the lower self; one avoids serving it by opposing desire and embracing the Lord's pleasure.
rows.anchor: طاغوت كل إنسان نفسه ؛ وإنما يجتنب الطاغوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning back to God means returning to Him in every matter.
rows.anchor: أي رجعوا إليه في كل شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Best” can mean simply good, or the superlative: good is what knowledge permits and the best is more fitting and correct.
rows.anchor: وفيه قولان ؛ أحدهما أن يكون بمعنى الحسن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The best speech is what is done for God alone or pure remembrance of Him.
rows.anchor: ويقال الأحسن ما كان لله دون غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inner promptings come from the self, Satan, an angel, or the Real, and each source calls toward a different response.
rows.anchor: هواجس النفس ووساوس الشيطان وخواطر الملك وخطاب الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Responding to God means keeping His covenant, fulfilling His due, turning from disobedience to companionship, and submitting to His decree; the path is open now but will close suddenly.
rows.anchor: الاستجابة لله الوفاء بعهده ، والقيام بحقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If people turn away, the Prophet is responsible only to convey the message; God knows how He will deal with them.
rows.anchor: فإن أعرضوا عن الإجابة فليس عليك إلا تبليغ الرسالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When given comfort and blessing, people rejoice arrogantly and turn safety into a means of disobedience; in adversity they deny God's favors and signs.
rows.anchor: وقابلها بالبطر ، وتوصل بتمام عافيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone decides who receives sons, daughters, a child, or barrenness; no one may object to His decree or choice.
rows.anchor: فلا اعترض عليه في تقديره ، ولا افتيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's established practice is to speak to people only by revelation or behind a veil; the servant, not God, is veiled.
rows.anchor: فلم يكلم أحدا إلا بالوحي ، أو من وراء حجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A veil means the opposite of vision is created in the place of seeing; God is not a body hidden behind a physical curtain.
rows.anchor: والحجاب أن يخلق في محل الرؤية ضد الرؤية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revealed Spirit is the Quran, which gives the heart life; another interpretation identifies the Spirit as Gabriel, also called the Holy Spirit.
rows.anchor: سماه روحا لأنه من آمن به صار به قلبه حيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet had not previously known the Quran or the detailed religious laws; God made the Quran a light guiding believers.
rows.anchor: ما كنت تدري قبل هذا ما القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All matters return to God because they began from Him.
rows.anchor: ألا إلى الله تصير الأمور } : لأن منه ابتداء الأمور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Not far away” reinforces that Paradise has been brought near; another reading reassures sinners.
rows.anchor: غير بعيد } : تأكيد لقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ever-returning person turns to God in every state and guards times, senses, and breaths for Him.
rows.anchor: الأواب : الراجع إلى الله في جميع أحواله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear of the All-Merciful is fear of separation joined with intimacy; it also reflects knowledge that God acts as He wills.
rows.anchor: الخشية من الرحمن هي الخشية من الفراق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reverent fear is subtler than ordinary fear and close to awe.
rows.anchor: الخشية ألطف من الخوف ، وأنها قريبة من الهيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse says a repentant heart, not an obedient self, so sinners may hope through sincere remorse even when their deeds fall short.
rows.anchor: لم يقل بنفس مطيعة بل قال : بقلب منيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Entering in peace means freedom from every affliction and lasting divine approval.
rows.anchor: ادخلوها بسلامة من كل آفة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Some are told by an angel to enter, while others are told that everything they wish for is theirs.
rows.anchor: ومنهم من يقول له الملك : ادخلوها بسلام

rows.speaker: أهل التفسير
rows.claim: Exegetes agree that the additional gift is the vision of God; some also say it is increased reward in Paradise, and the views do not conflict.
rows.anchor: اتفق أهل التفسير على أنه الرؤية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier, stronger generations explored the lands but found no escape; their destruction warns those who persist in error.
rows.anchor: انهمكوا في ضلالتهم ، وأصروا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: “A heart” may mean reason, an attentive or beneficent heart, or one awake and not intoxicated by heedlessness.
rows.anchor: أي من كان له عقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart listens outwardly to creation and inwardly to the Real; it may be alive, count its breaths, or remain alert to reflection.
rows.anchor: ألقى السمع } : استمع إلى ما ينادى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The report that hearts lie between two of the Merciful's fingers means they lie between two blessings: protection from harm and receipt of benefits.
rows.anchor: بين إصبعين من أصابع الرحمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report compares hearts to vessels: the unbeliever's is inverted, the hypocrite's broken, and the believer's sound so faith enters and remains.
rows.anchor: إن لله أواني ألا وهي القلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearts stained by emotional afflictions taint what enters them, while a heart cleared of disturbances is highest in rank.
rows.anchor: فقلب ملطخ بالانفعالات وفنون الآفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Weariness cannot touch God, the Self-Sufficient, because no change occurs in His essence.
rows.anchor: وأني يمسه اللغوب . وهو صمد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should endure claims about attributes from which God is transcendent and find relief in glorifying Him; solitude at night is clearest.
rows.anchor: فاصبر على ما يقولون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call comes from the Real suddenly and without a servant's choice, unlike ongoing whispered conversation among people.
rows.anchor: النداء من الحق - سبحانه - وارد عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone gives life and death, and everyone returns to Him.
rows.anchor: إنا نحن نحي ونميت وإلينا المصير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Resurrection is easy for God whether He raises everyone at once or individually.
rows.anchor: هذا يسير علينا : سواء خلقناهم جملة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is not a coercive overseer; Quranic warning benefits those who fear the promised punishment.
rows.anchor: ومآ أنت عليهم بجبار فذكر بالقرءان من يخاف وعيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is a reminder of the promised Fire of the afterlife and a provision for travelers who benefit from it on journeys.
rows.anchor: يتذكر بها الإنسان ما توعده به في الآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorifying the Lord means thinking deeply, diving through the strength of divine unity to find knowledge, and guarding faith from doubts.
rows.anchor: اسبح بفكرك في بحار عقلك ، وغص بقوة التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The enumerated signs prepare a path of inference and indicate the need for reflection.
rows.anchor: وهذه الآيات التي عدها الله - سبحانه - تمهد لسلوك طريق الاستدلال

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The oath by the stars' positions can refer to stars in the sky or the Quran's successive descents upon the Prophet's heart.
rows.anchor: قيل : هي مواقع نجوم السماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran is noble because nobility excludes baseness; the author also says this means it is uncreated and that it guides noble character.
rows.anchor: والكرم نفي الدناءة - أي : أنه غير مخلوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran is noble because it comes from a generous Lord, through a noble Messenger and a noble angel.
rows.anchor: من عند رب كريم على رسول كريم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hidden book is identified as the Preserved Tablet or written copies, and is protected from alteration.
rows.anchor: في اللوح المحفوظ . ويقال : في المصاحف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command may mean only the ritually pure should touch the codex; another reading says believers alone taste its blessing and monotheists approach it.
rows.anchor: خبر فيه معنى الأمر : أي لا ينبغي أن يمس المصحف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inward readings say only those purified of sin, low character, misery, or attachment to created things can reach the Quran's inner meaning.
rows.anchor: وقرئ المطهرون : أي الذين يطهرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The purified are also those who honor the Quran and fulfill its due, cleansed by felicity and then mercy.
rows.anchor: إلا المحترمون له القائمون بحقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran is sent down from the Lord of all worlds.
rows.anchor: { تنزيل من رب العالمين } أي : منزل من قبله - سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse accuses its hearers of hypocrisy toward the Quran and of denying it.
rows.anchor: أبهذا القرآن أنتم تنافقون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worldly life is transient, distracting, tempting but unsatisfying, and diverted from right guidance; it breeds adornment, boasting, and rivalry in wealth and children.
rows.anchor: الحياة الدنيا معرضة للزوال ، غير لا بثة ولا ماكثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the parable, “disbelievers” means farmers: the crop delights them, then dries and breaks apart.
rows.anchor: الكفار : الزراع . هو في غاية الحسن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The afterlife brings severe punishment to disbelievers and forgiveness and approval from God to believers.
rows.anchor: لأهله من الكفار . { ومغفرة من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The world is contemptible, its pursuer lower still, and the one who competes for it lower yet; it is carrion, and the miser is its worst inhabitant.
rows.anchor: الدنيا حقيرة - وأحقر منها قدرا طالبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Racing toward forgiveness means hastening to repentance, the deed that brings forgiveness.
rows.anchor: أي سارعوا إلى عمل يوجب لكم مغفرة من ربكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning the garden's width without its length implies proportionate length; its being prepared proves it already created.
rows.anchor: ذكر عرضها ولم يذكر طولها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse rejects the claim that obedience makes Paradise a debt God must pay, because grace is not an obligation.
rows.anchor: وفي ذلك رد على من يقول : ( إن الجنة مستحقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call to race reaches believers' inner selves, prompting their limbs to hurry gladly to fulfill God's rights.
rows.anchor: لما سمعت أسرار المؤمنين هذا الخطاب ابتدرت الأرواح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every earthly and personal event was recorded in the Preserved Tablet before creation and long before it occurred.
rows.anchor: لا يحصل في الأرض ولا فى أنفسكم شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage says enemies never receive this favor; their condition is marked by disorder and broken unity.
rows.anchor: ولا يكون ذلك للأعداء قط ؛ فليس فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Banu Qurayza's fate resembled Banu Nadir's: Nadir suffered its consequences a year before Qurayza did.
rows.anchor: مثل بني قرظة كمثل بني النضير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites' promised support for Banu Nadir resembles Satan urging someone to disbelieve and then disavowing him once he does.
rows.anchor: كمثل الشيطان إذ قال للإنسان أكفر فلما كفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People with false claims, lapses, or interrupted striving share this pattern despite differences; only Godfearing companions benefit, since other companions become enemies on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: هؤلاء كلهم في درجة واحدة في هذا الباب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first command to fear God means remembering punishment and reflecting on deeds; the second means vigilant self-accounting.
rows.anchor: التقوى الأولى على ذكر العقوبات في الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who neither audit deeds nor watch spiritual states will soon be exposed; concern for tomorrow is shown by attending well to today and reflecting on yesterday.
rows.anchor: ومن لا محاسبة له في أعماله ولا مراقبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some reflect on what was decreed from eternity, some on tomorrow, and others devote themselves to the present obligation, immersed in God beyond past and future.
rows.anchor: والناس في هذا على أقسام : مفكر في أمسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who forgot God abandoned obedience, so God left them in punishment and abandonment until they failed to repent.
rows.anchor: تركوا طاعته فتركهم في العذاب ؛ وهو الخذلان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People heedless of God do not equal people joined to Him; forgetting the Lord is the root of affliction and leads people to neglect repentance and procrastinate.
rows.anchor: لا يستوي أهل الغفلة مع أهل الوصلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If a mountain had reason, sound thought, and inner life, the Quran would humble and split it; the parable exposes hard human hearts, though another reading praises their strength to bear revelation.
rows.anchor: لو كان للجبل عقل وصلاح فكر وسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unseen is what cannot be known immediately or by inference, or what God reserves for Himself; the witnessed is what creatures can know, and nothing escapes God's knowledge.
rows.anchor: الغيب } : ما لا يعرف بالضرورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The names mean: King, with power to originate; Holy, transcending defects; Peace, free of defect, greeting saints, or keeping believers safe from punishment.
rows.anchor: الملك } : ذو القدرة على الإيجاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Believer confirms a servant's monotheism, affirms truth and His promise, and tells servants He keeps them safe from punishment.
rows.anchor: المؤمن } : الذي يصدق عبده في توحيده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Guardian means witness or trustee; the word may derive from security with its hamza changed to h, or mean the Believer.
rows.anchor: المهيمن } : الشاهد ، وبمعنى الأمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Mighty is unconquerable, peerless, worthy of majesty, ennobles His servants, and is inaccessible to others.
rows.anchor: العزيز } : الغالب الذي لا يغلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Compeller is beyond reach, mends people's affairs, and compels creation to fulfill His will.
rows.anchor: الجبار } : الذي لا تصل إليه الأيدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Supremely Great is transcendent above defects and originates entities and effects; the beautiful names denote beautiful named realities.
rows.anchor: المتكبر } : المتقدس عن الآفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True realization of the basmala appears in truthful speech grounded in proof, action free of innovation, conduct without self-congratulation, unveiled states, and breaths in direct awareness.
rows.anchor: اسم من تحقق به صدق في أقواله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites did not lie in saying Muhammad was God's Messenger; they lied by claiming sincerity and conviction, since a true statement does not help with a corrupt state.
rows.anchor: فهم لم يكذبوا في الشهادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Faith entails safety from punishment for the sinful believer, though the degree of escape may vary.
rows.anchor: الإيمان ما يوجب الأمان ؛ فالإيمان يوجب للمؤمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They used their oaths as a shield, hiding behind professions of belief while hypocrisy exposed them and brought its consequence.
rows.anchor: تستروا بإقرارهم ، وتكشفوا بنفاقهم عن أستارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They briefly received the light of response, but deprivation extinguished it and left them in the darkness of preordained wretchedness.
rows.anchor: استضاؤوا بنور الإجابة فلم ينبسط عليهم شعاع السعادة ، فانطفأ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites are bodies without inner understanding or reality, like hollow nuts whose appearance pleases children.
rows.anchor: هم أشباح وقوالب وليس وراءهم ألباب وحقائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They fear every shout because they lack reliance on God; their fluent friendly speech should not deceive the Prophet, since they are enemies.
rows.anchor: وذلك لجبنهم ؛ إذ ليس لهم انتعاش بربهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They turned away arrogantly when asked to seek the Prophet's forgiveness; counsel cannot reach them, and only punishment will end their heedlessness.
rows.anchor: سمعوا إلى ما يقال لهم على وجه التكبر ، وإظهار الاستغناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites are bound to material causes and veiled from divine apportionment; their words expose their wish to extinguish the Prophet's light, though provision belongs to God alone.
rows.anchor: كأنهم مربوطون بالأسباب ، محجوبون عن شهود التقدير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They misidentified the mighty and lowly: believers prevail while hypocrites are humbled; all honor ultimately comes from God.
rows.anchor: إنما وقع لهم الغلط في تعيين الأعز والأذل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's honor is divine sovereignty, prophetic honor is prophethood, and believers' honor is sainthood; another view says true believers do not remain eternally in Hell.
rows.anchor: لله عز الإلهية ، وللرسول عز النبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True faith does not disappear, taking strength from God prevents change, and honor lies only in obedience while disgrace lies only in disobedience.
rows.anchor: لا عز إلا في طاعة الله ، ولا ذل إلا في معصية الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not neglect religion for wealth or children: prioritize God's due and He will manage worldly needs; your obligation is to God, while He guarantees your provision.
rows.anchor: حق الله مما ألزمك القيام به ، وحقك ضمن لك القيام به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not trust safe circumstances; expect death suddenly, prepare to depart, and do not persist in procrastination.
rows.anchor: لا تغتروا بسلامة أوقاتكم ، وترقبوا بغتات آجالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Afflicted” means mad, from a word meaning to be tried by madness.
rows.anchor: المفتون : المجنون لأنه فتن أي محن بالجنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the worshiped One is one, the believer's aim and witnessed goal should also be one.
rows.anchor: معبودك واحد فليكن مقصودك واحدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those urging compromise wish everyone to share their sickness, just as those marked by separation wish opponents to experience it too.
rows.anchor: من أصبح عليلا تمنى أن يكون الناس كلهم مرضى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The contemptible oath-taker has fallen from God's regard and is kept far from Him.
rows.anchor: وهو الذي سقط من عيننا ، وأقميناه بالبعد عنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The slanderer who spreads tales is veiled from God and punished through backbiting against His saints.
rows.anchor: محجوب عنا معذب بخذلان الوقيعة في أوليائنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The miser who withholds good is disgraced and stripped of divine enabling.
rows.anchor: مناع للخير } . مهان بالشح ، مسلوب التوفيق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The transgressor is deprived of modesty and scattered through the valleys of deprivation.
rows.anchor: معتد أثيم } . ممنوع الحياء ، مشتت في أودية الحرمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ignoble person has no virtue, argues fiercely for falsehood, and gains no good.
rows.anchor: لئيم الأصل ، عديم الفضل ، شديد الخصومة بباطله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should not obey a denier merely for his wealth and sons; when Quran is recited, he dismisses it as ancient fables.
rows.anchor: قابلها بالتكذيب ، وحكم أن القرآن من الأساطير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will mark the denier's nose at the Resurrection, disfiguring him so he can be recognized.
rows.anchor: سنجعل له في القيامة على أنفه تشويها لصورته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One account says a Yemeni orchard owner let the poor glean what escaped harvest; after his death, his sons refused to continue giving and God destroyed the garden.
rows.anchor: وكان للمساكين كل ما تعداه المنجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account says God replaced their garden with a better one; they then planned to harvest before dawn before the poor noticed, without saying “if God wills.”
rows.anchor: وقيل : أبدلهم الله جنة حسنة ، فأقسموا ليصرمن جنتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God tested the people addressed after the Prophet prayed against them, afflicting them with famine until they ate carrion; this is compared with the orchard owners' trial.
rows.anchor: حين دعا عليهم النبي ، فابتلاهم الله بالجوع ، حتى أكلوا الجيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A calamity from heaven struck while the orchard owners slept and burned their fruits, leaving the garden like a harvested field.
rows.anchor: أرسل عليها من السماء آفة فأحرقت ثمارهم
